rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7,522.90, the settled close of 16 Jun 2026 - the last completed cash session strictly before the report date D = 17 Jun 2026 - read from the slice on the cash-session basis (16:30-23:00 broker). The report's own 7,548.60 is +25.70 against this and fails the 3-pt close tolerance, so every level here is re-derived from the slice, not from the report's price table. BASIS: all figures on cash-session bars, the basis the report's asset (the S&P 500 cash index) trades on and the basis the QA reference uses. ATR14 = 103.03 index points, mean true range over the 14 cash sessions ending 16 Jun 2026 (TR = max(H-L, |H-PrevC|, |L-PrevC|)); the report's asserted ~150 is 46% high and is discarded. Full-day-bar ATR14 on the same window is 117.14, quoted only because the linter recomputes on that basis. DIRECTION: the report's §21a conviction score is +0.30 LONG, above the 0.25 threshold, so Trade 1 is not suppressed on the conviction gate. ENTRY: M5 §5.1 sets Trade 1 as a market or just-fillable order at the daily-open anchor, and §5.0 fixes the fill level at the D-1 reference close, so entry = 7,522.90 exactly. The report's buy limit 7,558 with a conditional market fallback is a dual-mode entry sitting 35.10 above the reference close - the wrong side for a long limit - and is rebuilt, not annotated. ANCHOR: 09:00 broker. The report states 07:00 UK in its §2 session note and again in its §20 log, where it records the anchor as 'overridden to 07:00 UK per run instruction'. M5 §5.0 and §9a row 4 forbid re-selecting a fixed anchor at run time, and a run-time instruction is not authority to do so; the standing anchor therefore governs. No level moves either way, because with the broker clock at UTC+3 and the UK on BST, 07:00 UK converts to exactly 09:00 broker - the report's own stated time and the standing anchor are the same instant. STOP: M5 §4c takes the tighter of the 5-day swing extreme or the nearest support, with a 0.25 x ATR14 = 25.76 buffer beyond it, capped at 3.5 x ATR14 = 360.60. Candidates below the reference close, tightest first: the 16 Jun session low 7,518.20 (nearest support in the 5-day structure) less the buffer = 7,492.44, giving R = 30.46 = 0.296 x ATR - below the 0.30 x ATR floor of 30.91, which M5 §9a row 6 requires be rebuilt rather than warned; next, daily S1 7,503.60 less the buffer = 7,477.84, giving R = 45.06 = 0.437 x ATR, inside the 0.3-3.0 band and well inside the 3.5 x ATR cap; last, the 5-day swing low 7,260.00 (11 Jun 2026) less the buffer = 7,234.24, giving R = 288.66 = 2.80 x ATR, compliant but far wider and it would carry the wide-stop flag. The tightest compliant anchor is daily S1, so stop = 7,477.84 and R = 45.06 points. PIVOTS: daily floor pivots from the D-1 session itself (16 Jun 2026 cash H 7,571.40 / L 7,518.20 / C 7,522.90) per M3 Step 8, P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7,537.50, R1 = 2P-L = 7,556.80, S1 = 2P-H = 7,503.60, R2 = P+(H-L) = 7,590.70, S2 = P-(H-L) = 7,484.30, R3 = H+2(P-L) = 7,610.00, S3 = L-2(H-P) = 7,450.40. Identity check R2-P = P-S2 = H-L = 53.20 holds. The report's daily pivots are 19.30-24.60 points high because they are built on its own uncorroborated 16 Jun H/L/C. TARGETS: M5 §5.1 gives TP1 = entry + 1R = 7,522.90 + 45.06 = 7,567.96 (+45.06 pts) and TP2 = entry + 2R = 7,613.01 (+90.11 pts). TP1 sits 45.06 points from entry, inside the 2.5 x ATR = 257.57 reachability bound. TP3 is the runner: session-close time stop, or the 3 x ATR14 price cap at 7,522.90 + 309.09 = 7,831.99 (+309.09 pts), whichever comes first; it is printed as a number rather than left as prose, and it is beyond TP2. The report's extracted tp3 of 7,800 appears nowhere in the report text and is discarded. LADDER: 7,477.84 < 7,522.90 < 7,567.96 < 7,613.01 < 7,831.99, ordered for a long. SUPPRESSION GATES TESTED: conviction +0.30 vs threshold 0.25 - does not fire; ATR14 present, positive - does not fire. NO SWING FIB LEVEL IS USED ON THIS CARD, so no fib percentages apply here.

strategy: Trade 2 - Pivot, TRANSITION branch (breakout side only) - SUPPRESSED
entry_mode_text: n/a - suppressed. No entry, stop, R or target ladder is carried.
management_text: SUPPRESSED - the breakout geometry this branch fixes cannot satisfy the risk band. The pivot corroboration objection is withdrawn: the daily pivot tier is recomputed from the broker price series the order would be filled and settled against and is CORROBORATED. On that tier the TRANSITION breakout is entirely rule-fixed - buy stop at 7,539.43 (10% of the way from the daily pivot 7,537.50 to R1 7,556.80) with the stop at 7,510.38 (80% of the way from the pivot down to S1 7,503.60) - giving R = 29.05 points = 0.28 x ATR(14) of 103.03, below the 0.30 x ATR floor of 30.91. Neither leg carries any discretion that could widen it, so the card is not rebuildable and is carried as a suppressed row. No entry, stop, R or target ladder is carried.
rationale: REBUILT IN THE CORROBORATION CORRECTION PASS. The prior version of this record suppressed the card on the pivot-corroboration gate - 'all accessible pivot tiers SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE'. That was a misapplication and is withdrawn here. That gate exists to stop a card being built on a prior-period high/low that cannot be established: a tier struck from narrative or aggregator quotes about the market. It does not reach a tier computed from the broker price series, because that series is the one the resulting order is filled and settled against - the settlement source itself, not a secondary quote about it - so a tier struck from it is corroborated by construction, with nothing for a second source to corroborate it against. The prior session inherited the report's indicative flag, which described a different and weaker input (the report's own reconstructed intraday open/high/low fields), instead of setting the flag from the input actually used here. M5 §5.2a and §10 now state this in terms. REUSED, UNCHANGED FROM THIS DATE'S OTHER RECORDS: reference close 7,522.90, the settled cash close of 16 Jun 2026, the last completed session strictly before D = 17 Jun 2026; ATR(14) = 103.03 index points over the 14 cash sessions ending 16 Jun 2026, cash-session bars (16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET); regime label TRANSITION, the same label that forks Trade 3 to 3C. PIVOT TIER, RECOMPUTED AND ITS FLAG SET FROM ITS OWN INPUT: the daily floor pivots are computed per M3 Step 8 from the prior-period high/low/close of the 16 Jun 2026 cash session, read directly off the US500 broker M15 execution price series in data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-06-16.csv (last bar 2026-06-16 23:45:00 broker): H 7,571.40 / L 7,518.20 / C 7,522.90. P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7,537.50, R1 = 2P-L = 7,556.80, S1 = 2P-H = 7,503.60, R2 = P+(H-L) = 7,590.70, S2 = P-(H-L) = 7,484.30, and the midpoint R1.5 = (R1+R2)/2 = 7,573.75. Identity check R2-P = P-S2 = H-L = 53.20 holds. CORROBORATION FLAG: CORROBORATED. Series named: the US500 broker M15 price series, the execution and settlement series for this order. Session named: the 16 Jun 2026 cash session, 16:30-23:00 broker. The flag describes the provenance of the high/low/close actually used to strike the tier, not the provenance of any figure quoted elsewhere in the report; the report's Investing.com 16 Jun range and its own reconstructed intraday fields are not inputs to this tier and their status does not attach to it. The suppression trigger that fired on the prior version therefore does not fire. BRANCH: TRANSITION. M5 §5.2c permits the breakout side only, mirroring the §5.2b breakout geometry with R1/R1.5/R2 on the upside. The side is the upside - the side Trade 3C carries as the direction its break would take - so a long breakout-side construction is the permitted one and a counter-side limit is not available. That gate does not itself suppress. SUPPRESSION TRIGGER THAT FIRES - RULE-FIXED GEOMETRY CANNOT SATISFY THE R BAND: on the corroborated tier, entry = P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) = 7,537.50 + 0.10 x 19.30 = 7,539.43, taken as a buy stop; it sits 16.53 points above the reference close, the correct side for a buy stop, so the order-side rule passes. The stop is P - 0.8 x (P - S1) = 7,537.50 - 0.8 x 33.90 = 7,510.38. R = 29.05 points = 0.28 x ATR(14), below the 0.30 x ATR floor of 30.91 points. M5 §9a row 6 requires that a card outside the 0.3-3.0 band be rebuilt rather than warned, and this branch offers nothing to rebuild with: both the entry and the stop are fixed multiples of P, R1 and S1 with no discretionary lever. The one alternative the stop rule admits - 'just below S1 minus 0.25 x ATR' - is not available and would not help if it were. It is conditioned on a confluence sitting just below S1 7,503.60, and none does: the 5-day swing low is 7,260.00 (11 Jun 2026), 243.60 points below; weekly S1 is 7,287.87, 215.73 below; and the prior-day low 7,518.20 is 14.60 points ABOVE S1, not below it. Were it invoked regardless, S1 - 0.25 x ATR = 7,477.84 gives R = 61.59 = 0.60 x ATR but is the wider of the two candidates, and the rule takes whichever is tighter - which is 7,510.38 again. Widening the stop to clear the floor is not a rebuild available under the rules; it is a relaxation of a fixed geometry, and the gates are not overridable by convenience. NO OTHER PIVOT TIMEFRAME RESCUES THE CARD: the weekly tier from the prior completed week (2026-06-08..2026-06-12 cash) gives P 7,387.13 / R1 7,531.17 and a breakout entry of 7,401.53; the monthly tier on the May 2026 cash basis (H 7,601.80 / L 7,177.50 / C 7,584.80) gives P 7,454.70 / R1 7,731.90 and a breakout entry of 7,482.42. Both sit below the reference close of 7,522.90, which is the wrong side for a buy stop under M5 §5.0, so neither is a compliant substitute and neither is shipped with a note. The daily tier is the only one that produces a correct-side breakout entry, and it is the one that fails the R band. OTHER GATES TESTED AND LOGGED: pivot corroboration - the daily tier is CORROBORATED, does not fire (this is the correction); regime branch resolved to TRANSITION and the breakout side resolved to the upside, correct branch and side selected, does not itself fire; ATR(14) present and positive at 103.03, does not fire; the conviction gate governs Trade 1 only and Trade 2 does not inherit direction from the direction score, so it is not applicable here. The R-band failure is the single ground on which this card is suppressed. Per M5 §10 a suppressed card is a row and not a card, so no entry, stop, R or target ladder is carried in the priced fields; the geometry above is recorded for audit only. For completeness the targets that geometry would have carried are R1 7,556.80 / R1.5 7,573.75 / R2 7,590.70, and the thesis invalidation would have been a daily close back through P 7,537.50.

rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7,522.90, the settled cash close of 16 Jun 2026, the last completed session strictly before D = 17 Jun 2026. ATR14 = 103.03 index points on the 14 cash sessions ending 16 Jun 2026, cash-session bars. FORK: the regime label is TRANSITION, as the report resolves it in its §9, and the Trade 3 mapping is fixed with no discretion - TRANSITION forks to 3C, the momentum-breakout. The report's card is headed 3A, the momentum-pullback fork that belongs to a TREND label, and is then built as a breakout stop entry over the 16 Jun high, so it is neither the fork the label selects nor the geometry its own heading claims. A variant may not be substituted because its levels look more tradeable; where the selected variant fails its own eligibility test the outcome is the suppressed row. RANGE DEFINITION: the 25-session boundaries from the slice are swing high 7,624.60, printed 2 Jun 2026, and swing low 7,243.10, printed 9 Jun 2026, giving a width of 381.50 points. ELIGIBILITY TEST THAT FAILS: a confirmed break requires a daily close beyond the boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 25.76 points. Upside that is a close at or above 7,624.60 + 25.76 = 7,650.36; downside a close at or below 7,243.10 - 25.76 = 7,217.34. The 16 Jun reference close of 7,522.90 is 127.46 points below the upside level and 305.56 above the downside one, and no session in the window closed beyond either boundary - the 25-session high itself was set two weeks earlier and has not been reclaimed. Without the confirming close the trade is not eligible, and the suppression trigger for no confirmed break in a TRANSITION regime fires. The direction recorded is the side the breakout would take if it were confirmed - upside, on the report's read of a five-session recovery pressing the range top with the failed retests at the upper boundary - but no order, level or ladder is carried. HAD THE BREAK BEEN CONFIRMED, the geometry would have been stop = range low + 0.40 x width = 7,243.10 + 152.60 = 7,395.70, TP1 = entry + 1.0 x width = entry + 381.50, TP2 = entry + 1.5 x width = entry + 572.25, recorded for audit only. NO FIB RETRACEMENT APPLIES: the 57.5% / 38.2% / 0% / 100% ladder belongs to the 3A fork, which this label does not select. For the record the qualifying swing on the slice would have been 7,260.00 on 11 Jun 2026 up to 7,583.40 on 15 Jun 2026, magnitude 323.40, which clears the 2 x ATR14 = 206.06 threshold - but 3A is not the fork here and its levels are not emitted.
